sub_fields.label: Featured Video URL
sub_fields.name: url
sub_fields.instructions:
Past the entire youtube URL. It must be a Youtube URL

ex: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PLTL0FiV_3o

sub_fields.label: Featured Video Image
sub_fields.name: image
sub_fields.instructions: Upload an image that is either 1920x1080 or 1280x720

sub_fields.label: Featured Collection Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: This is the title displayed before showing this collection. Keep it short.

sub_fields.label: Feature Category or Tag
sub_fields.name: category_or_tag
sub_fields.instructions: For the featured collection section on the homepage, you can either have the posts be pulled from a category, or from a tag. Please select one. External (curated) shows up to 3 items you enter by hand, for example firefox.com articles.

sub_fields.label: External items
sub_fields.name: external_items

sub_fields.label: Label Text

sub_fields.label: CTA 2 Text

sub_fields.instructions: If you need a secondary CTA, you can use this. This is not required
